# Vikas Rathore - Training Officer (COPA), Government ITI Torla, Raipur

## Summary
Vikas Rathore is a Training Officer for the COPA (Computer Operator and Programming Assistant) trade at Government ITI Torla, Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India. He is a 1st Rank Topper in both Diploma in Electrical Engineering and ITI COPA (NCVT).

## Education & Academic Achievements
- CITS (Craft Instructor Training Scheme) in CSA (Computer Software Applications) from NSTI (R), Hyderabad
- ITI in COPA (NCVT) from Odisha — 1st Rank Topper
- Diploma in Electrical Engineering from JK Institute of Engineering, Bilaspur, Chhattisgarh — 1st Rank Topper
- NIELIT Hyderabad Certifications: O Level, CCC+, ECC, and CCC

## Industrial Experience
- 1 Year Diploma Apprenticeship Trainee (Electrical) at National Thermal Power Corporation Ltd. (NTPC – 2600 MW), Korba, Chhattisgarh
- 15 Days Vocational Training at 132 KV Substation, SECL (Coal India Ltd.), Gevra, Korba, Chhattisgarh

## Technical & Programming Skills
- Programming Languages & Development: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, PHP, Python, C, C++, R Programming, Mobile & Web App Development
- Vocational Training: Computer Fundamentals, MS Office, Digital Skills, and Hindi/English Typing
